question: How is the fourth chapter of this tantra formally identified and concluded?
premises: The chapter concerns Mahākālī mantra worship
inference: This concludes the fourth chapter on Mahākālī mantra worship in the Kaṅkālamālinītantra of the southern transmission.
plain_english: Thus ends the fourth chapter, named the exposition of Mahākālī mantra worship, in the Kaṅkālamālinītantra of the southern transmission, a work of one and a half lakh verses.
